Create a fresh scratch org, use its existing administrator and create a second synthetic administrator. Substitute their usernames for the placeholders in the two populated auth-provider metadata files before deployment. The synthetic Salesforce-managed auth providers and registration handlers make no authentication requests or callouts. Through the data API at 62.0 and 67.0, query the three providers and require one saved null and two different populated IDs for each field before recording each ORDER BY variant. PluginId lacked two distinct populated parents and is a setup skip.
